# Faraz Ansari

> Personal portfolio and digital marketing writing by Faraz Ansari, a London-based Senior Digital Marketing Executive at OKI Europe.

The blog combines first-hand professional lessons on digital marketing, AI, SEO and CRM with approved personal essays about everyday experiences, conversations and social questions. They distinguish work periods from publication dates and identify supporting sources. These are the author's views, not official statements from OKI Europe.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio](https://farazansari1701.com/): Professional experience, education, certifications, projects and contact information.
- [Writing: work and life](https://farazansari1701.com/blog/): Professional marketing articles and personal perspectives.
- [About Faraz Ansari](https://farazansari1701.com/blog/about/): Author biography: a London-based marketing career, roots in Varanasi and Mussoorie, the move to the UK, education and first-person perspectives.

## Articles and topics

- [B2B lead quality: looking beyond cost per lead](https://farazansari1701.com/blog/b2b-lead-quality-cost-per-lead/): An educational framework for audience fit, qualification and campaign measurement.
- [B2B marketing automation: HubSpot lessons from OKI](https://farazansari1701.com/blog/hubspot-marketing-automation-lessons-oki/): A personal reflection with a practical automation checklist and answers to common questions.
- [Marketing automation](https://farazansari1701.com/blog/topics/marketing-automation/): Topic archive.

- [Personal perspectives](https://farazansari1701.com/blog/topics/personal-perspectives/): Approved first-person essays based on daily reflection and lived experience.

- [RSS feed](https://farazansari1701.com/blog/feed.xml): Published article feed.
